contains: This construction is available to any two parties who hold a VRC between them, regardless of whether they share membership in a VTC.
Community membership is **not** a precondition for issuing, holding, or presenting a VRC
When both parties to a VRC hold VMCs from the same community
Migration from M-DID-based to R-DID-based edges recommended post-bootstrapping for enhanced privacy.

findings.observation: The revised source defines a pairwise VRC proof independent of shared-community membership and a separate community-anchored proof for parties sharing a VTC.
findings.inference: The source now distinguishes general relationship proof from community-derived assurance, resolving the documentary interpretation gap identified in SR-201.
limitations: Resolution is limited to the specification text. No implementation interoperability or cryptographic proof construction was independently validated.
findings.treatment: Retain the pairwise/community-anchored distinction and test implementations separately when executable ZKP profiles become available.

risk_reasoning.RK-SC02: The revised text removes the specific ambiguity about whether shared-community membership is required for all VRC proofs; broader credential interoperability remains outside this finding.

findings.observation: The M-DID bootstrapping and recommended post-bootstrapping migration text is unchanged in the reassessed revision.
findings.inference: The source change does not close the residual linkability window because migration remains recommended rather than triggered by a normative condition.
limitations: No deployed registry, governance policy or actual migration behavior was examined, so operational treatment may exist outside this specification.
findings.treatment: Keep the residual issue open until a normative or governance-controlled migration trigger is evidenced.

risk_reasoning.RK-ID05: The maintained risk continues to apply because the reassessed source retains the same M-DID bootstrapping exception and non-normative migration language.
